title: the evidence-first *gtm intelligence os*
dek: A source-grounded system that turns customer truth into a problem-qualified universe, independently valuable message, and compounding learning loop without confusing personalization, activity, or simulation with proof.
lens: customer dossiers · message-market fit · GTM engineering

sections.heading: the real advantage is *information asymmetry*
sections.body:
Jordan Crawford's method is not a copy framework or a lead-scraping recipe. The durable asset is a customer truth base that preserves observed actions, verbatim language, operator claims, model inference, and unknowns as different evidence classes.

That truth base makes the worst version of a problem visible, makes the right market enumerable, and gives the operator enough information advantage to create something useful for the recipient before asking for a sale. The message becomes a compressed expression of the targeting evidence.

sections.heading: the source mechanics that govern it

rows.evidence: The primary interview argues that the message re-describes the targeting; the system therefore routes generic copy upstream before rewriting.

rows.claim: Customer dossiers are the durable intelligence layer
rows.evidence: The public dossier material centers customer actions and voice while separating durable knowledge from changing reasoning.

rows.claim: Research is optimized by right-answer economics
rows.evidence: The primary interview explicitly frames the operating metric as dollar per right answer, supporting a deterministic-to-model-to-human escalation ladder.

rows.claim: Fewer evaluated units can outperform agent sprawl
rows.evidence: Public Blueprint writing and the compounding-units video favor bounded units with evaluation and review over horizontal context fragmentation.

sections.heading: what is *locked* now
sections.dek: One upstream owner, bounded downstream craft, and proof states that cannot be inflated by language.

items.action: Owner: Jordan governs customer truth through message-market-fit learning
items.why: Adjacent positioning, offer, copy, and RevOps experts receive source-locked handoffs; they do not compete for upstream ownership.

items.action: Evidence: facts and reasoning remain separate stores
items.why: Facts and quotes survive reinterpretation; conflicts, failed searches, and unknowns remain visible.
Outreach, publishing, CRM writes, paid enrichment, and global promotion require explicit approval.
A local connected system exists; portability, privacy, cold-start, and real-world outcome proof must precede packaging.

sections.heading: the 10-workflow operating spine
sections.body:
Workflows 1–3 establish truth. Choose the dossier path when evidence exists, the zero-data path when it does not, then qualify the worst observable problem across segment, company, and person.

Workflows 4–6 build the market and the value. Map observable indicators, enumerate and disqualify the universe, choose research methods by right-answer cost, then create a PVP that helps before a purchase.

Workflows 7–10 operate and compound. Freeze one message hypothesis, keep external execution approval-gated, unitize only proven steps, hand source-locked evidence to one craft owner, and return outcomes to the dossier.

sections.heading: what this *doesn't prove*
sections.body: Structural validation, source fidelity, router discovery, and synthetic behavior tests prove a locally usable B-tier capability. They do not prove real message-market fit, customer demand, revenue, Jordan's private implementation, or objective world-best status. The blind pass is self-judged; A-tier embodiment requires Farrice's judgment on real work. Plugin packaging remains parked until cold-start portability, privacy, and real-world outcome proof exist.
